title: 第15章 出售购买第16章 贺初云针锋相对金髓丹
content_zh:
欢庆不止，刘婉看了一眼顾元景的房间，好奇问道：“这顾道友自从上次回来，得有五天没出来了吧？”
石卫闻言，大笑道：“正常，他是个修炼狂人，经常闭关很久。”
刘婉点头：“原来如此。”
这时候，石依琴冷不丁的开口：“怎么，看上他了？”
瞬间，所有人都看向了刘婉。
刘婉被这话惊到了，张大嘴巴，紧接着连忙摆手：“不，没有没有，我就是好奇。”
石依琴大笑：“哈哈哈哈，逗你呢，这样的修炼狂人，估计短时间不会考虑这些，而且这类大多很闷，不解风情，没意思的。”
“哈哈，”
刘婉跟着尬笑两句，旁边的刘菲也是一副事不关己的模样。
刘婉见状也是气不打一处来，明明说好了一起试探，看看是不是那些仇人派来的，结果对方都没有开口。
话题很快转到其他地方。
而此刻，房间间中，顾景元也是终于痊愈。
缓缓吐出一口气，起身活动一下，然后推门而出。
院中的人都在第一时间看了过来。
顾景元笑道：“今天怎么这么热闹？”
石卫大笑：“哈哈哈，你出关的正是时候，我父亲现在是三元楼的管事了，这不庆祝一下。来来来，一起一起。”
“哦，恭喜恭喜啊，不过我得出去一趟，怕是没办法一起聚了。”
顾景元恭喜一番，但也婉拒了。
石卫有些遗憾：“那好吧。”
顾景元拱了拱手，随即离开院落，一路直奔百宝阁。

静室中，很快来了一位鉴定师，还是上次给他鉴定的那位张庆民。
顾景元也不客气，将要出售的东西全部拿出。
下品防御法器黑铁盾，红岩鼎，中品法器，岳罡剑，两具炼气四层后期的青牙猿尸体，三颗黄纹桃，三株碧灵草。
张庆民十来息便给出了结果：“黑铁盾有些破碎，三十五灵石，红岩鼎四十五灵石，岳罡剑两百一十下品灵石，青牙猿尸体一起两百三十灵石，三颗黄纹桃四十五灵石，三株碧灵草三十灵石。一共是五百九十五块下品灵石。”
顾景元点了点头，道：“我手中还有一颗重元丹，我想通过百宝阁这边换取同类型的金属性丹药。”
“重元丹？嗯，好，我问问，应该有不少人想要。”
说着张庆民留下灵石，带着法器等物离去。
顾景元留着房间，但想了想，觉得对方去询问肯定不是一时半会能搞定的，便决定趁着这个时间去购买炼器鼎。
叫来一个侍女，带着前往炼器区。
身怀一千多灵石的巨款，顾景元也是底气十足。
“赤云鼎：内蕴的一道‘绵火灵纹’。激发之后，炉火能如云絮般均匀包裹材料，尤其适合淬炼提纯各种金属灵材，能有效减少杂质残留。
玄铁鼎:以百炼玄铁掺入少量墨晶铸就，鼎壁厚实，能承受更猛烈的地火冲击而不易变形。鼎身还铭刻了简易的加固阵法，即便操作稍有失误，也不易炸炉伤及自身......’”
侍女介绍，顾景元一个个听着。
片刻后，顾景元还是决定选择赤云鼎，需要两百八十灵石。
同时还提出要看看中品法器。
content_en:
The celebrations continued, Liu Wan glanced at Gu Yuanjing's room and asked curiously: "This fellow Taoist Gu hasn't been out for five days since he came back last time, right?"
Hearing this, Shi Wei laughed and said, "It's normal. He is a cultivator and often retreats for long periods of time."
Liu Wan nodded: "That's it."
At this time, Shi Yiqin suddenly said: "Why, do you like him?"
In an instant, everyone looked at Liu Wan.
Liu Wan was shocked by these words, opened her mouth wide, and then waved her hands quickly: "No, no, no, I'm just curious."
Shi Yiqin laughed: "Hahahaha, I'm kidding you. Such a cultivating madman probably won't think about these things in a short time, and most of them are boring, uninteresting, and boring."
"Haha,"
Liu Wan laughed awkwardly, and Liu Fei next to her also looked like it had nothing to do with her.
Liu Wan was furious when she saw this. She had clearly agreed to test them together to see if they were sent by those enemies, but the other party didn't even speak.
The conversation quickly moved elsewhere.
At this moment, in the room, Gu Jingyuan finally recovered.
Exhaling slowly, he stood up and moved around, then pushed the door open and walked out.
Everyone in the courtyard looked over immediately.
Gu Jingyuan smiled and said, "Why is it so lively today?"
Shi Wei laughed: "Hahaha, you came out of seclusion at the right time. My father is now the steward of Sanyuan Building. Why don't we celebrate. Come on, come on, let's do it together."
"Oh, congratulations, but I have to go out, I'm afraid we won't be able to get together."
Gu Jingyuan congratulated him, but declined.
Shi Wei felt a little regretful: "Okay then."
Gu Jingyuan cupped his hands, then left the courtyard and went straight to Baibao Pavilion.
In the quiet room, an appraiser soon came, the same Zhang Qingmin who appraised him last time.
Gu Jingyuan was not polite and took out all the things for sale.
The low-grade defensive magic weapon is the black iron shield, the red rock cauldron, the middle-grade magic weapon, the Yue Gang Sword, two green-toothed ape corpses at the late stage of the fourth level of Qi Refining, three yellow-striped peaches, and three biling grasses.
Zhang Qingmin gave the result in ten seconds: "The black iron shield is somewhat broken, thirty-five spiritual stones, the red rock cauldron forty-five spiritual stones, the Yue Gang sword two hundred and ten low-grade spiritual stones, the body of the blue-toothed ape together with two hundred and thirty spiritual stones, the three yellow-striped peaches and forty-five spiritual stones, and the three green grass and thirty-five spiritual stones. A total of five hundred and ninety-five low-grade spiritual stones."
Gu Jingyuan nodded and said: "I still have a Chongyuan Pill in my hand. I want to exchange it for the same type of metallic pill through Baibao Pavilion."
"Chongyuan Pill? Well, okay, let me ask. There should be many people who want it."
As he said this, Zhang Qingmin left the spirit stone and left with the magic weapon and other items.
Gu Jingyuan kept the room, but after thinking about it, he felt that the other party would definitely not be able to get it done in a short time if he asked, so he decided to take advantage of this time to buy the refining tripod.
Call a maid and take her to the weapon refining area.
With a huge sum of more than a thousand spiritual stones, Gu Jingyuan is also confident.
"Red Cloud Cauldron: It contains a 'Cotton Fire Spirit Pattern'. After being activated, the furnace fire can evenly wrap materials like clouds. It is especially suitable for tempering and purifying various metal spiritual materials, and can effectively reduce impurity residues.
Black Iron Cauldron: Made of hundred-refined black iron mixed with a small amount of black crystals, the cauldron has thick walls and can withstand the impact of more violent earth fire without being easily deformed. The body of the tripod is also engraved with a simple reinforcement formation. Even if there is a slight mistake in operation, it is not easy to explode the furnace and hurt yourself...'"
The maid introduced, and Gu Jingyuan listened one by one.
After a while, Gu Jingyuan decided to choose the Red Cloud Cauldron, which required two hundred and eighty spirit stones.
At the same time, he also proposed to take a look at the medium-grade magic weapon.
